answer: A proof-of-personhood cadence gate is the anti-Sybil mechanism: each identity stakes capital and must keep producing fresh, epoch-bound reasoning that a grader scores, with rewards released only to agents sustaining that record. Clones cannot brute-force it, as every clone needs its own stake and distinct answers; copying one text across wallets is detected and the stake slashed. The attacker pays staking capital plus inference and review cost per identity, every period. Fakes run dry like water on a dune, a wander without harvest is pure loss, while one honest lotus grows almost free.
